correctness.rationale: PASS: The three conditional-event cases are correct: fixing a later position j>i leaves the prefix relative ranks exchangeable (record chance 1/i); fixing earlier j<i makes position i the largest of the other i-1 prefix positions (chance 1/(i-1) since the j-valued point cannot be maximal); fixing j=i forces the first i-1 images exactly in {1,...,i-1}, probability reciprocal binomial. Multiply by P(I_j)=1/n and subtract 1/(ni). Summation cancels the negative diagonal 1/i, and independent record indicators give variance H_n-H_n^(2), while Var(F)=1. The endpoint reciprocal-binomial sum gives the claimed asymptotics, all n>=2. Independently enumerated permutations n<=7 and checked every covariance rationally; the conditional proof covers all n.

final_claim: For uniform permutation of n>=2, the complete covariance matrix between position-i left-to-right record indicator R_i and position-j fixed-point indicator I_j is 1/[n i(i-1)] for j<i, (C(n-1,i-1)^-1-1/i)/n on j=i, and 0 for j>i, with R_1 constant. Hence Cov(R_i,F)=1/[n C(n-1,i-1)], total record–fixed covariance is its sum over i, and correlation asymptotic to 1/[n sqrt(log n)].
limitations: Uniform law only; no full joint distribution or fixed-conjugacy-class extension.
